| `get_current_speed` | Get the vehicle’s current speed. | – |

| `liter_to_gallon` | Convert liters to gallons. | `liter` |
| `lockDoors` | Lock or unlock specific doors. | `unlock`, `door` |
| `pressBrakePedal` | Press the brake pedal to a given position. | `pedalPosition` |
| `releaseBrakePedal` | Release the brake pedal. | – |
